item.title: Almost €100,000 For Midwest Charity’s Victims Of Racism Project
item.description: A Midwest migrants’ rights charity has received funding of almost €100,000 for a project aiming to support victims of racism. Doras has been awarded €98,539 under the Department of Justice’s Ireland Against Racism Fund which provides funding to initiatives intended to combat racism and promote racial equality and community cohesion. item.title: Ennis Track’s Niall Murphy Helps Ireland To Team Gold At U23 European Cross Country Championships
